summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of the guest-cart + login-at-checkout flow for SHOPbaked / MARTbaked per Fixing_Prompt.docx. All 10 requested scenarios (TEST 1 through TEST 10) PASSED on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Guest can browse, add, view, mutate quantities, and remove items on both /shopbaked cards, /shopbaked PDP, and /cart page without any auth prompt. Login is only triggered on the CartPage's 'Login to Proceed' button, which stashes sessionStorage.baked_post_login=/checkout, opens the shared phone-OTP/Google/Email dialog, and preserves localStorage.baked_guest_cart on cancel. On successful login the guest cart is merged into the server cart via /api/shop/cart/items (upsert on duplicate variant confirmed by TEST 6 — item A qty preserved + item B added), guest cart drained to {items:[]}, and the customer lands on /checkout with a populated order summary. Authenticated regression (TEST 9): + button on ShopHome card correctly hits POST /api/shop/cart/items (server cart, no localStorage write), and /cart 'Checkout' button navigates straight to /checkout with no login modal.
critical_code_review_comments: BakedContexts.jsx line 274 sets `product_id: it.variant_id` for the guest SHOP row (used as the outward product_id when hydrating) — this looks intentional (so cart page can dedupe against variant_id) but is confusing given the guest row structure also carries product_id at the top level. Consider renaming to `sku_id` or documenting the shadowing.

BakedContexts.jsx mergeGuestIntoServer swallows individual line failures silently (`catch (e) { void e; }`). Fine per Fixing_Prompt §11 (server revalidates), but at minimum log a warning so support can trace lost lines during login-merge.

CartPage.jsx line 165 — the checkout button is disabled ONLY when customer && (!minOrderOk || hasUnavailable). For guests the button is always enabled which is correct (need to open login), but consider disabling if items.length===0. Currently empty-cart branch renders a different UI so it's ok, just noting.
test_credentials: Phone OTP: +91 9990001234 (dev_code echoed via /api/auth/otp/request dev_code field). Same account used for TEST5, TEST6, TEST9. baked_post_login sessionStorage redirect verified end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded demo SHOP products shpprd_demo_pieces-accessoires-moto, shpprd_demo_outils-entretien, shpprd_demo_pieces-voiture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest cart uses localStorage key `baked_guest_cart` with items shape { id: 'gs_<variantId>', module: 'shop', variant_id, product_id, quantity, snapshot: {title,image,price,compare_at_price,currency,sku,variant_attributes,product_id} }. Auth uses PhoneLoginDialog testids auth-phone-input, auth-country-code-select (native <select>, use select_option), auth-send-code-btn, auth-otp-input-0..5, auth-verify-code-btn. dev OTP returned as `dev_code` in /api/auth/otp/request JSON. Desktop top nav has auth-open-login-btn; mobile uses the profile tab or 'Login to Proceed' on MobileCart sticky CTA (text-based, not testid). SHOP PDP add-to-cart testid = shopbaked-pdp-add-to-cart. SHOP card add testid = shopbaked-card-add-<productId>. CartPage checkout testid = cart-checkout-btn; label switches: 'Login to Proceed' (guest) / 'Checkout' (authed).

test_results.TEST7_cancel_login: PASS — Esc closes modal, remains on /cart, 2 rows still present.

test_results.TEST9_authenticated_regression: PASS — POST /api/shop/cart/items called (server cart write, 0 localStorage entries), CartPage button reads 'Checkout' when authed, clicking it navigates to /checkout with no modal opened.
